items.title: Paris: Protest starts at Porte d'Italie, after last-minute change to the route
items.summary: France is bracing for another day of cost-of-living protests, with extra police deployed nationwide to prevent a repeat of the violence that followed last Saturday’s demonstrations. In Lyon, where protests have been banned, police used tear gas to disperse around 150 people who had gathered to demonstrate. Government figures put last weekend’s turnout at more than half a million, and similarly large crowds could take to the streets again today. The movement grew out of high school students’ protests over poor conditions and a lack of resources, and cities across the country have stepped up security. In Paris, the Louvre, Orsay and Picasso museums are closed, while many luxury boutiques have also shut their doors and boarded up their windows following last weekend’s looting. France 24 Journalist Elitsa Gadeva reports the latest.

Cowboys receiver George Pickens was rewarded for a stellar contract year by being kept from getting a fair market deal. Although his per-game targets and catches through six 2026 games are roughly comparable to his 17-game average in 2025 (8.66 targets and 5.5 catches in 2026 versus 8.05 and 5.47 in 2025), his yards per game are down (71.3 yards per game in 2026 and 84.0 in 2025). He has only one 100-yard game and only one touchdown this year. (In 2025, he had five 100-yard games and nine touchdowns.) Meanwhile, questions have emerged about Pickens's effort, especially when the ball isn't coming his way. Coach Brian Schottenheimer addressed that issue in a Thursday session with the media.

Letter: Emma Sainsbury questions whether government policy takes sufficient account of people whose caring responsibilities shape their finances and ability to keep a home For 13 years, I have cared for my lovely 101-year-old adoptive mum who requires round-the-clock care. I feel blessed to care for her and have no regrets. But love does not pay the bills. Carer’s allowance is £86.45 a week for 2026-27. Spread across 168 hours, that is roughly 51p an hour. As a sole carer, I have no downtime. I still work part-time as a self-employed therapist when Mum’s health allows, but when she is poorly, my work stops while the bills continue.

For the first time in school history, Satellite completed an undefeated regular season as the Scorpions shut out Tradition Prep 53-0. On Oct. 22, the Scorpions completed a remarkable turnaround with their ninth win of the season defeating Tradition Prep 53-0 for their first undefeated season in school history. "For a team that was 1-9 two years ago, I think it's great for these guys to complete a season like they just did," Satellite head coach Dan Burke said. "On the practice field and in games, there's always a lot we can get better at but the consistency, we're proud of them. They've come through every week. We've been challenged and they've answered every single time."

​Before you throw away that jar with only a bit left inside, turn it into a dressing, sauce, glaze or even a drink instead Making a dressing with the last inch of honey is perhaps the most efficient and satisfying way to deal with a near-empty jar. Pour in a bit of boiling water and some lemon juice, orange juice or red-wine vinegar, screw on the lid, then shake aggressively so the honey dislodges and dissolves into a syrup. The vaccine was custom-brewed for each patient to match their tumor. Once the world's largest producer of mink pelts, the nation's industry has declined in recent years. Mink farming will end in Denmark by August 2029 after the government decided to drop plans to pursue an exemption to an EU-wide ban on the practice. Denmark was once the largest producer of mink fur in the world, but the industry has declined due to global bans on fur farming, a decline in the fur trade and an earlier outbreak of a Covid strain in the nation's mink population. The ban is due to come into effect on 7 August next year, and is followed by a two-year transition period to phase out the practice.

Birds' compact nervous system seems to help them handle tasks very quickly. But avian brains that don’t have a neocortex, so it wasn’t obvious how they made similar decisions. “This was the big question,” said Andreas Nieder, a neurobiologist at the University of Tübingen. “How [would] a differently organized avian brain encode decisions?” To find out, Nieder and his colleague Philipp Schmidbauer put two carrion crows through the same task the monkeys faced, recording their brain activity along the way. The crows solved the task the same way primates do, using the same mathematical logic despite having a very different brain structure. And they did it two times faster.

The ICC has confirmed dates for the LA 2028 Olympic cricket qualifiers. The LA 2028 Olympic cricket qualifiers will be held in January and February 2028. Cricket's return to the Olympic Games has moved a step closer, but the road to Los Angeles has also changed in a few important ways. The ICC has confirmed that the men's and women's qualifiers for the LA 2028 Olympics will be played in January and February 2028, and it has also revised how the final automatic women's place will be awarded. McAllen, Texas — Benny Melendez, the owner of a small construction company along this stretch of the U.S.-Mexico border, says he's been forced to take drastic measures to protect his immigrant workers. "If I don't install fences, ICE is going to come into my property and take my workers away," Melendez said as he showed CBS News the fencing he's set up at one of the several construction sites he manages in South Texas. Melendez says the fencing is designed to prevent U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents from arresting his workers, and to require them to have judicial warrants before entering his job sites.

The Denver Broncos have dominated their all-time series against the Arizona Cardinals. The Broncos and Cardinals have played just 12 times in the regular season in their team histories; the first matchup happened between the then-St. Louis Cardinals and the Broncos in 1973, a game which produced the series' only tie, a 17-17 draw. After their second-ever game in 1977, the matchup took a 12-year hiatus before resuming in 1989. It has been played on a more regular basis since then. In doing so, Blakely became the first gymnast to compete in NCAA gymnastics and win a world all-around title in the same calendar year. She also joins Gator grad Leanne Wong — who claimed silver in 2025 — as the only gymnasts to medal in the world all-around final in the same year they competed collegiately. Additionally, Blakely was the only gymnast at the 2026 championships to qualify for four individual finals: all-around, vault, uneven bars and balance beam.

Remembering a Yankees outfielder from the dawn of the franchise. Determined not to lose his New York franchise, AL president Ban Johnson worked behind the scenes during the 1914-15 offseason to strengthen the team's roster, making it more attractive for a prospective new ownership group. He did so by encouraging the rest of the league's teams to sell the Yankees useful players at a reasonable price. The first team to heed his call was the Tigers, who sold New York two players: a first-base prospect named Wally Pipp and a 27-year-old outfielder named Hugh High.

An approaching lockout could accelerate free agency, while a proposed salary floor raises questions about Colorado's future spending. More than 30 years later, Major League Baseball is once again approaching a potential work stoppage that could leave the Colorado Rockies with less than a month to conduct much of their offseason business. MLB's free-agent market opens shortly after the World Series, with players permitted to sign with new teams five days after the final out. But the current collective bargaining agreement expires December 1, and another lockout is widely anticipated.

They already have three losses, equaling the total from 2026. The road doesn't get any easier with the Kansas City Chiefs and former Seahawks legend Kenneth Walker III returning to Lumen Field for a prime time matchup. Will Seattle be able to keep Walker under 100 yards, continuing their own defensive streak of holding rushers under that mark? That was the focus of this week's poll .

The Yankees need a solution for their third base problem, but with a weak free agent class, New York may need to stand pat with their internal options to start the 2027 season. It wasn't long ago that they had Jazz Chisholm Jr. learn the position on the fly when they acquired him at the 2024 trade deadline. And since then, they've acquired Ryan McMahon, Amed Rosario and Jose Caballero over the years to help fill the hot corner, without any of them able to capture it. McMahon has been the biggest disappointment. While his defense has still been above-average, his offensive struggles have helped create the black hole in the bottom part of the Yankees' lineup.
